notes: No public-IPv4 line item exists anywhere on OCI's price list (checked 2026-08-18), and the public-IP docs have no billing section. $0 here is evidence of absence, stated as such.
Reserved and ephemeral public IPs both uncharged.
"All reserved IPs are free when assigned to a Droplet" — DO docs, read 2026-08-18.
A reserved IP left UNASSIGNED bills ~$7.00/month ($0.01/hour), citing IPv4 scarcity.
Every Linode has "a single public IPv4 address" included; additional addresses require technical justification rather than payment — techdocs, read 2026-08-18.
